name: Grid Meter
description: The grid connection point's three-phase power analyser (reference model Janitza UMG 604-PRO, Modbus TCP): phase voltages, frequency, signed active power (+ import / - export), import and export energy registers. Used by the energy-grid process.

models.name: UMG 604-PRO
models.purpose: Power quality analyser at the grid connection point - the site's import / export, the phases' voltage, current and frequency.
